newsitem.title: CANADA: Rio Algom to issue C$500 mln of debt, shrs.
newsitem.headline: Rio Algom to issue C$500 mln of debt, shrs.

text.p: RBC Dominion Securities said on Wednesday a syndicate of Canadian investment dealers agreed to purchase a new issue of common shares and subordinated convertible debentures of Rio Algom Ltd at an aggregate purchase price of C$500,061,000.

RBC, which will manage the syndicate, said the underwriters agreed to purchase 176,700 units, each comprised of C$2,000 principal amount of 5.5-percent subordinated convertible debentures of Rio Algom due February 1, 2007, on an instalment basis and 25 common shares of Rio Algom at a price of C$2,830 per unit.
The deal is expected to close by about February 4,1997.

On closing investors will pay C$1,830 of the purchase price of each unit, C$830 of which represents payment in full for the 25 common shares in each unit (C$33.20) and the remaining C$1,000 of which represents payment of the first instalment of the purchase price for the C$2,000 principal amount of debentures in each unit.

RBC said the final instalment of C$1,000 will be payable on the first anniversary of closing, and the units will be non-separable for a period of 60 days after closing, or such earlier date as the underwriters determine.
The debentures will be convertible into common shares of Rio Algom at any time after payment of the final instalment and prior to maturity at an effective price of C$40 per share.

The debentures will be non-redeemable prior to February 2000, will be redeemable thereafter until February 2002 only if the market price of the common shares exceeds 125 percent of the conversion price for a specified period, will be redeemable thereafter at any time, and will be subordinated to all other unsubordinated debt of Rio Algom, RBC said.
